[00:00] Sarah: Hey everyone, thanks for hopping on. Quick preface, this is a cross-company kickoff to align on the Summit session and the outreach campaign. Can we do quick intros?
[00:12] Tom: Yeah, hi I'm Tom Reed, I run events at VectorScale, uh we have Lina and Priya on the call too.
[00:18] Lina: Hey all, Lina, demand gen, working the nurture track.
[00:21] Priya: Priya here, product marketing, I'll own speaker assets and slides.
[00:25] Marco: Marco, Redwood SE, I'll handle the tech/run of show and rehearsal.
[00:29] Jia: Jia on marketing ops, I'll do pages and tracking.
[00:33] Sarah: Great. First agenda item: session selection. We proposed two tracks — one on "Serving LLMs at scale" and the other on "Cost-aware inference for product teams". Which resonates more with your audience?
[00:45] Tom: The cost-aware one hits our customers better, they'd like practical takeaways. But serving at scale is sexy. Maybe we do a hybrid title?
[00:53] Priya: Hybrid could be "Serving LLMs: practical cost and latency playbook" — short and actionable.
[01:03] Sarah: I like that. We'll note the session title and make sure slide deck matches a 25-minute talk plus 10 min Q&A.
[01:12] Marco: Quick note on format — do we want live demo? Live demo adds risk, but a short recorded segment + live Q&A is safer.
[01:21] Tom: Agree, last year's live demo hiccup was rough. Pre-record one critical demo clip and rehearse.
[01:28] Lina: For the promotional angle, we want a clear CTA — download checklist or sign up for POC. Any preference?
[01:34] Sarah: Let's make the CTA 'request a pilot' with a short checklist asset. Redwood can own the checklist creation.
[01:41] Priya: We'll draft the checklist, can we get a model snippet and a couple of screenshots?
[01:47] Marco: I'll export a 90-second demo clip showing deduped KV cache example — sorry, KV cahsh, I mean KV cache.
[01:54] Sarah: Cool. Next, registration page and UTMs. Jia, what do you need from VectorScale?
[02:01] Jia: Need confirmation of co-branding logo, privacy blurb, and their lead routing email endpoint — do they want leads pushed to their Salesforce or to Redwood?
[02:12] Tom: We'd like primary leads into our SFDC, but Redwood can get a webhook copy. We'll map fields.
[02:19] Sarah: We'll propose a lead map doc and shared google sheet with field mappings. I'll own the doc.
[02:25] Lina: Also want to make sure we capture company size and use case as a required field for segmentation.
[02:31] Jia: We'll add custom fields and hidden UTMs for campaign source/medium/content. Recommend utm_source=vectorcale (typo) — wait, need correct spelling, VectorScale. We'll finalize.
[02:42] Priya: On email copy, we'll produce two variants for A/B testing: 1) Technical deep dive, 2) Business outcomes. We should align subject lines.
[02:51] Sarah: Good. For promotion cadence, what's the ideal send schedule?
[02:55] Tom: We usually do three sends: announce (3 weeks out), reminder (1 week out), last-chance (2 days out), plus social.
[03:05] Lina: Add a targeted nurture for MQLs post-event — 3-email sequence.
[03:10] Marco: Re: rehearsals, propose one tech check 1 week prior and a full dress rehearsal 2 days prior.
[03:17] Sarah: Recording and post-event asset strategy — we should have the session recorded and gated on the landing page for lead capture. Redwood can host the video on S3 and provide embed.
[03:27] Tom: Are there any compliance or privacy concerns with capturing attendee data?
[03:31] Sarah: We'll supply PII handling notes. VectorScale may require SOC2 info; we can share Redwood security doc.
[03:37] Priya: Good, we'll need that for legal review.
[03:40] Sarah: Okay moving to run-of-show. Marco, can you sketch a 40-minute timeline?
[03:45] Marco: Yep, proposed: 00–02 intro & housekeeping, 02–25 main presentation, 25–35 live Q&A, 35–40 closing CTA and next steps. If we hit 40, we will be tidy.
[03:57] Tom: Works. Can we also add a 5-minute sponsor callout?
[04:01] Sarah: Sure, 1 minute sponsor mention before Q&A.
[04:06] Lina: For speaker bios, we need 50–75 words and headshots. Tom — can your speaker provide by Friday? (2025-08-15)
[04:13] Tom: Yes, I'll check and confirm.
[04:16] Sarah: Great. Now about tracking and reporting: after event, how will leads be shared and SLA?
[04:22] Tom: We want CSV export into SFDC and Redwood should push us a copy within 24 hours.
[04:27] Sarah: Redwood can push webhook and also upload CSV to shared folder within 24 hours. We'll capture tags for campaign and session.
[04:34] Priya: Do we want a joint debrief within a week?
[04:37] Lina: Yes, debrief + lead scoring review.
[04:40] Sarah: Noted. Now, marketing assets: deck versioning, co-branding colors — Priya, any brand constraints?
[04:47] Priya: VectorScale requires brand color hexs and logo placement — they prefer left-side logo, 15% opacity on footer.
[04:54] Jia: We'll build a template and share as Google Slides.
[04:57] Marco: AV needs — 1080p screen share, 30 fps, presenter's mic recommended. Also if we do a recorded demo, we need lossless audio.
[05:07] Sarah: Any budget for paid social or LinkedIn ads?
[05:10] Tom: VectorScale can fund a small sponsored post boost — around $1k. Redwood can handle the targeting if helpful.
[05:16] Lina: We'll coordinate targeting segments — job titles, industries, company size.
[05:21] Sarah: Good. Competitors and noise — do you see competing events that week?
[05:26] Priya: There's a smaller vendor meetup, but no large conf. Timing looks fine.
[05:30] Sarah: Ok, let's capture risks: speaker drop, registration low, demo failures. Mitigations: backup speaker, boost ad, pre-record demo.
[05:39] Tom: On legal/procurement side, any contracts needed?
[05:42] Sarah: We have a co-marketing agreement template — I'll send it. VectorScale legal can redline.
[05:47] Priya: We'll need it 2 weeks before event ideally.
[05:50] Jia: Technical detail: does Redwood need IP permission to host video?
[05:54] Marco: Yes we'll get asset grant language in the contract.
[05:58] Sarah: All right, walking through timeline and deadlines: run-through of due dates.
[06:03] (several speakers talking over each other briefly)
[06:12] Sarah: I'll summarize action items after call. Marco, any items on the infra side?
[06:17] Marco: Need the model names we plan to mention; any open-source model will be fine, but if we reference Redwood Dedicated specs, watch wording. Also, we'll avoid disclosing internal perf numbers — use ranges.
[06:31] Tom: Understood. Regarding creative: can Redwood provide a short tagline?
[06:35] Sarah: We'll propose two taglines by tomorrow: 1) "Practical plays for production LLMs" 2) "Cutting cost, not capability" — open to edits.
[06:46] Priya: Liking #1 but tweak.
[06:48] Lina: Small note — make sure CTA aligns with VectorScale lead process.
[06:51] Sarah: Yep.
[07:00] (brief pause, typing sounds)
[07:10] Tom: Quick Q — onboarding for registrants: do we send automated confirmations and calendar invites?
[07:15] Jia: Yes, registration page will auto-send confirmation and calendar invite. We'll include ics attachment.
[07:21] Sarah: For the registrants, can we add a short optional question about current inference spend band? That helps qualify.
[07:28] Priya: Might reduce conversions if too many fields. Maybe make it optional.
[07:33] Lina: Agree optional. We'll use progressive profiling in nurture.
[07:38] Marco: Tech rehearsal checklist — attendees, slide deck final, presenter internet speed test, mic test, demo clip playback.
[07:46] Sarah: I'll add to the doc.
[07:49] Tom: Any GDPR concerns? We have EU attendees, make sure the consent box is present.
[07:54] Jia: We'll include consent and privacy language; opt-in checkboxes.
[07:58] Sarah: Good. Now scheduling: target event date is 2025-09-11, is that still good?
[08:05] Tom: Yes Sept 11 works. Two weeks earlier would be tight.
[08:08] Priya: Need final slides by 2025-09-04 to prep recording.
[08:12] Sarah: OK.
[08:15] (Silence for a few seconds)

[08:24] Lina: We can tap our partner newsletter and one sponsored LinkedIn post.
[08:28] Tom: VectorScale has a reseller list; might push to that channel too.
[08:32] Sarah: Let's align on co-branded social assets and approved messaging by 2025-08-18.
[08:36] Priya: We'll need social copy and 4 variation images.

[08:47] Sarah: Sarah — run-of-show and lead map doc. Marco — AV checklist and demo clip. Jia — landing page & UTMs. Tom — speaker bio. Priya — slides and email drafts. Lina — promo cadence.

[09:03] Marco: Yes we can auto-generate captions and then we'll edit for accuracy. Transcription might have minor mistakes.
[09:11] Sarah: OK final items — legal will need co-marketing agreement. I'll send first pass tomorrow.
[09:16] Priya: Can we have weekly check-ins?
[09:18] Sarah: Yes, propose Thursdays at 10am PT starting 2025-08-14.
[09:23] Lina: Works for me.
[09:24] (Some overlapping confirmations)

[09:35] Tom: Thanks.
